svg.title: Local Probability Refinement for Precise Object Detection
svg.desc: One image passes through the backbone and encoder. A shared four-direction Mamba field is built from stride-8 memory and sampled at native candidate positions. The final decoder distribution, query-conditioned visual cues, and actual candidate gaps drive one shared adjacent-pair head. Local conservative transfers correct the final distribution before Integral, LQE, FGL, and GO-LSD consume it. The total one-dimensional Wasserstein distance is bounded by 5% of the uncorrected final box width or height. Native denoising and losses are retained. The overview remains visible while the details change.
